info.title: What is protected?
info.board: The Board is {public}: everyone who can reach this server can read it, and the server stores it in plain text.
info.encrypted: Encrypted channels are encrypted on your device with a key derived from the channel name and passphrase. The server only stores ciphertext.
info.protects: passive Wi-Fi sniffing and anyone reading the server's disk.
info.notProtects: an active attacker who can modify this page's code on plain HTTP (for example a rogue hotspot). Put Fyr behind HTTPS (a reverse proxy) for that.
info.anyone: Anyone with the passphrase can read everything and post under any nickname; nicknames and device tags are not verified.
info.weak: A weak passphrase can be guessed offline by someone who captures the channel id. Use 4+ random words.

shareLink.intro: Share this link (the part after {hash} never reaches the server):
shareLink.includePassphrase: Include the passphrase in the link — anyone who sees the link or QR code can read and post.
shareLink.noPassphrase: The passphrase is not kept on this device, so links contain the channel name only.
shareLink.qrAlt: QR code for the share link

composer.public: Public — readable by everyone on this network.

messages.loginToPost: Posting requires an admin login on this server. You can still read the Board and channels you have keys for.
